query: SELECT c.id AS "id!" FROM twitch_clips_social_media c LEFT JOIN social_media_clip_enrichment e ON e.clip_db_id = c.id WHERE c.discarded_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(c.upload_local_path, c.local_file_path) IS NOT NULL AND (e.status IS NULL OR e.status IN ('pending', 'failed')) AND c.id BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT $1
